name: Welcome tour
description: A multi-page tour defined entirely as JSON.

steps.title: Welcome to svelte-tourlight
steps.content: This tour is a plain JSON document. It spans two pages, survives a reload, and one step waits for you to click the real button.

steps.title: Light, dark or auto
steps.content: Pick a theme. Every colour is a CSS variable you can override.

steps.title: Click the real button
steps.content: This step is interactive. Press the counter itself to continue.

steps.title: Steps follow you across pages
steps.content: We navigated to Settings for you. Reload the page now and the tour picks up right here.

steps.title: That's it
steps.content: Tours are data, so you can review them in pull requests and validate them against the JSON Schema.
